hero.title: A System For Your Kennel Club Office
hero.subtitle: Dog registry, litters, pedigrees, and members in one auditable system — instead of Excel and paper.

problem.title: Paper and Excel Don't Scale
problem.description: Running a pedigree registry, breeder files, and payments by hand invites errors and makes it hard to keep control of what's happening in the office. What you need is a system that holds all of it in one place — with a full history of every change.

solution.title: What The System Covers
solution.subtitle: Built and battle-tested on our own POK CRM system for kennel club offices.

features.title: Pedigree Registry
features.description: A full dog registry with pedigree relationships — parents, litters, kennel names.

features.title: People Directory
features.description: Members, breeders, and owners in one database — one person can hold multiple roles.

features.title: Pedigree Issuance
features.description: Generate and track issued pedigree certificates, each with a snapshot of its source data.

features.title: Champion Titles
features.description: Track titles and achievements attached to specific dogs.

features.title: Payments
features.description: Track payments tied to specific people and dogs.

features.title: Full Audit Trail
features.description: Every change in the system is logged — who changed what, and when.

multiTenant.title: One System, Many Clubs
multiTenant.description: Each kennel club operates in its own, fully isolated data space — with its own roles, permissions, and organization settings. One club's data never mixes with another's, even inside the same system.

security.title: Data Security & Continuity
security.description: Regular backups and rehearsed changes against a local copy before anything touches production — because issued pedigrees are documents your clients already hold in their hands.

cta.title: Want To Deploy This For Your Club?
cta.subtitle: Let's talk about what your records look like today and what can be automated. An initial quote is free.
